doc.title: Hentoff Nat — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Born in Boston, 1925, and his given names
summary: Hentoff gives his birth date and place, mentions his memoir Boston Boy, and explains his first and middle names.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: I was born on June 10th, 1925, in Boston, Massachusetts, where I grew up until I came to New York in 1953 as the New York editor of Down Beat. I wrote about those interim years in a book called Boston Boy. Boston at the time won a prize, if that’s the word for it, as the most anti-Semitic city in the country.
Nat, what was your name at birth? Was it Nat Hentoff, or Nathaniel?
Your first name. Is it Nat?
My first name, which I hardly ever use, is Nathan. There’s a middle name, Irving, after some relative. But I’ve been Nat for a very long time.
